brief:
The Petroleum Authority in Gaza announced Tuesday that five trucks carrying cooking gas had entered the territory, according to Shehab Wire. The delivery represents a fresh supply of fuel to the coastal enclave amid ongoing shortages of essential commodities.

Gaza has faced severe fuel constraints in recent months, making deliveries of cooking gas a critical resource for residents. The authority did not specify the source of the shipment, the timeline for distribution, or whether additional supplies are expected in coming days.
